situation: Three close friends in their thirties.
topic: One of them was cheated on and vents violent revenge fantasies about her ex, hyperbolic and graphic, and the others egg her on with darker jokes.

text: Ok I need to vent and you two are the only ones who won't tell me to be the bigger person 😤
He's such a coward. Found out off a screenshot his mate sent my sister. Not even him telling me
Ah ciara
Ok im here. Is this kyle
Yes kyle. 14 months. And the girl is a physio from lisburn apparently
A physio. So she'll be quite fit then
Conor
Thank you conor
Honestly I'd have him somewhere up the antrim hills with a very bad sense of direction
I've been picturing him getting his knackers caught in a lawnmower. Slowly. With him watching
Ok thats a bit much but im listening
Get him on a live site with me for an afternoon and he'll be in bits by lunch. Nothing I'd say on the record
You wouldnt actually
I wouldnt. I'd just tell him the wires were live and watch him read the panel for 20 mins
Hes the sort who'd cry at a funeral he caused
He'd cry at a wetherspoons receipt
He called me "unstable" in the text. Like its my fault he went and shagged a physio
Unstable I'd be unstable too if I'd just lost 14 months and a decent kitchen
Im not even mad about the kitchen
Ok im a bit mad about the kitchen
You should be. That was your grandad's dresser
Anyway. Birthday. I said I'd do tues or thurs?? Ciara are you still free thurs for drinks
Thurs works. I've a valuation in dundonald at 9 so not a late one
On a call out in holywood thurs till 5 probably. Can be there for 7
7 is fine. The crown?
The crown is full of tourists somewhere on the lisburn rd
Botanic inn is still going. 5 mins from the end of the rd
Botanic inn works
He's posted a photo of her on a beach in donegal. Caption is "new chapter"
No photo of me. She's wearing my actual coat
Oh that's a clean slap
A coat's a coat, don't let it get in your head
It was a 300 quid coat conor
Then she's in a 300 quid coat and he's on a beach in donegal in the rain. Thats his punishment
Rain in donegal is the most violent thing I've ever heard of
I want him to get a parking ticket every day for a year and have to go into the council offices in person to dispute each one
Thats the most diabolical thing anyone's said in this chat and I've been in it since 2019
Ok im off to bed. I have a 9am. Thanks for letting me be unhinged
You're allowed to be unhinged. See you thurs at the botanic and you can be unhinged in person
Cant sleep. Keep picturing him reading the text I sent him
Don't read anything into it, he's a numpty
I wrote him a 900 word message and didnt send it
Good. Save it for when you can say it to his face and watch him try to say sorry
Send it to me, I'll tell you if it's any good
Absolutely not
Worth a try
Up already. 9am viewing in ballynahinch. Couple looking at a 3 bed like its the louvre
Ballynahinch on a Sat morning is a bold choice
[screenshot: client email]
"Can we make the logo bigger but also more subtle." Monday deadline. Ok we're doing this
Thats not a brief thats a riddle
Make it bigger, then make it smaller, then send them the bigger one
Conor you are not helping me as a designer
Im an electrician, my help is always a bit off
She's commented "cant wait to see you" under his beach photo
Put the phone in a drawer
Already looked at her profile. Shes got a dog called biscuit
Dont look at her profile
Too late. Biscuit is a lurcher
Secret santa budget is 15 right. Someone in accounts drew me and im already stressed
15 yes. Dont go mental, Declan spent 40 last year and it was a sad candle
Who was the candle for
Nobody knows. He wont say
[photo: fuse box with scorch marks around the main breaker]
Holywood. Man wired this himself in 2009 and thought the earth was optional
Is he alive
Yeah he's at the kitchen table watching me like im the one who did it
Ok thats the best thing I've read all day
I sent him something. Cut it to two lines
Ah ciara
What did it say
That he's a coward and he owes me a kitchen. That's it
Fair enough. Thats a good two lines
He's read it. Blue ticks
No reply
Blue ticks and nothing is worse than a reply
Dont check it again
Checking it again
Sorry being useless today. Client wants a call Monday morning and I've been on the phone since 2 about a logo that's green. Not even a nice green
What green
The green of a Lidl sign
Tell them its bold
I've said it's bold. They want it bolder
Going for a walk round the lagan then home. Need air
Wrap up, its brass monkeys
Mon I'm on a site in newtownabbey from 7 so no late ones this week
Thurs is still on. Botanic inn. Unhinged in person
Is it bad that im scrolling through 2019 photos of us for the reason
Yes. Mute him and put the phone down
Mute, dont delete. Deleting just makes it a story
Muted
Cant sleep again
Put on a film. Not a romcom
Die hard
Good choice
Die hard is a christmas film and I won't be taking questions
He's replied. Just "I hope youre ok"
I'm ok
Don't reply. Not tonight
Agreed. Sleep ciara
